## 1. Identification Strategy
Difference-in-differences comparing reformed and non-reformed regions before and after
period 3; parallel trends is the identifying assumption.

## 2. R Code
I would estimate a two-way fixed-effects regression of y on treat_x_post with unit and
period fixed effects, but I have not written the code here.

## 3. Expected Findings
We expect a positive effect: higher saving rates, an increase of about 10 points.
